notes.title: Common Redistributables Update
notes.content:
Some player reported crashes after events related with Steam achievements. I can't reproduce the error on my system, so I pass to some fellow testers, however [b]nobody could reproduce the error[/b]. So after testing, I'm sure the [b]crash must be related to .NET installation[/b] so I added .NET and C++ to common retribution.

* Add .NET to Steam common retribution.
* Add Visual C++ to Steam common retribution.

Thanks, and an apology, to [b]Rainbow Robin[/b] to point this out.
